data.body: Implementation note: gate_dispatch.py stood at 799 LOC, so the cancel plumbing tripped the 800-LOC module-size gate. Split along the existing call-graph seam: the plan-review failure tail (STEP_* ids, _attach_plan_review_metrics, the coach/verify recovery reconstructions, _degraded_plan_review_verdict, and the new _cancelled_plan_review_verdict) moved to src/rebar/llm/workflow/plan_review_tail.py (292 LOC leaf, no back-import), re-exported from gate_dispatch for callers/tests. Also: tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_assemble_memo.py neutralizes the cancel probe in its read-accounting harness (the probe's deliberate fresh single-ticket reads sit outside the assemble memo and are covered by test_plan_review_cancel.py). All other mechanics landed exactly as planned; plan review passed round 1.
